- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1/search-get): Lists transactions. Specify one or more query parameters to filter the transaction that appear in the response.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api/transaction-search/v1/balances-get): List all balances. Specify date time to list balances for that time that appear in the response.
